anomalies.description: A small cylindrical device placed on the lawn detonates, producing a rapid expansion of gas/vapor and ejecting debris (including the cap) upward and outward in slow motion.

A sudden violent rupture of a plastic bottle on the grass, ejecting fragments and liquid in all directions, consistent with a pressure-driven explosion.; A second explosion occurs in the same garden area, with a transparent object (likely a plastic bottle or container) violently rupturing and fragments dispersing in slow motion.
A plastic bottle detonates on a lawn, producing a rapid expansion of vapor and shrapnel (plastic fragments) visible in slow motion; the explosion originates from ground level near a house.
A second explosive event in a field: a plastic bottle ruptures violently, sending debris and vapor upward; a yellow object (possibly a cap or fragment) is ejected high into the air.
A yellow plastic castle-shaped object is punctured by a drill bit, causing an immediate rupture and ejection of material—consistent with a small-scale pressure-driven explosion or burst.
